claim.statement: The Phase 229.5 rewrite of _geoid_entropy is load-bearing for the entire reasoning loop. The pre-Phase-229.5 formula computed Shannon entropy of embedding-dimension magnitudes, which (per the rewrite comment) 'always yields ≈0.93 for 300D unit vectors, destroying selectivity.' Without the fix, entropy_proxy ≈ 0.93 every cycle → α_gamma ≈ 1.36 every cycle (always supercritical) → gamma always leads → no behavioral differentiation. The variance in the post-fix formula is what makes reasoning vary.
claim.operationalization: The Phase 229.5 comment at line 33178 documents the pre-fix degeneracy. Compute the expected α_gamma if entropy_proxy were the pre-fix constant ≈0.93: α_gamma = 2·0.93 − 0.5 = 1.36 (strongly supercritical, always gamma-leading). Post-fix, entropy_proxy varies across cycles → α_gamma varies → different reasoning regimes possible.

claim.h1: Phase 229.5 fix is required for reasoning to differentiate across cycles
